_meta.title: CompTIA Network+ Basics
_meta.description: Starter pool with foundational networking, protocols, addressing, and operations questions aligned to common Network+ objectives.

questions.text: At which OSI layer does IP operate?
questions.explanation: IP is a network layer protocol responsible for logical addressing and routing.

questions.text: Which protocol is connection-oriented and provides reliable delivery?
questions.explanation: TCP uses acknowledgments and sequencing to provide reliable transport.

questions.text: Which transport protocol is commonly used for fast DNS queries?
questions.explanation: DNS typically uses UDP for standard queries because it is lightweight and fast.

questions.text: What subnet mask corresponds to a /24 network?
questions.explanation: A /24 prefix means the first 24 bits are network bits, which equals 255.255.255.0.

questions.text: What is the purpose of a default gateway?

answers.text: Send traffic to destinations outside the local subnet

questions.explanation: The default gateway forwards traffic for remote networks.

questions.text: Why is NAT commonly used on edge routers?

answers.text: To allow private addresses to share public IPv4 space

questions.explanation: Network Address Translation lets many private devices use fewer public IPv4 addresses.

questions.text: What is a primary benefit of using VLANs on a switch?

answers.text: They remove the need for IP addressing
They turn switches into firewalls automatically

questions.explanation: VLANs segment traffic logically and reduce unnecessary broadcasts.

questions.text: Which service resolves hostnames like example.com to IP addresses?
questions.explanation: The Domain Name System translates names into IP addresses.

questions.text: What does a DHCP scope define?

answers.text: The pool of addresses available for lease

questions.explanation: A DHCP scope contains the address range and options a server can lease to clients.

questions.text: A switch makes forwarding decisions primarily based on which information?
questions.explanation: Layer 2 switches forward Ethernet frames using MAC address tables.

questions.text: What is the main function of a router?

answers.text: Connect different IP networks and forward packets between them

questions.explanation: Routers operate at Layer 3 to move traffic between networks.

questions.text: What does PoE provide over Ethernet cabling?

answers.text: Electrical power to devices such as phones or access points

questions.explanation: Power over Ethernet supplies power and data on the same cable.

questions.text: Which protocol helps prevent Layer 2 switching loops?
questions.explanation: Spanning Tree Protocol blocks redundant paths to avoid loops.

questions.text: Why is fiber-optic cabling often preferred for very long runs?

answers.text: It supports long distances and is resistant to electromagnetic interference
It can only be used indoors
It always costs less than copper

questions.explanation: Fiber supports longer links and is not affected by EMI the way copper can be.

questions.text: Which wireless security standard is the most modern of these options?
questions.explanation: WPA3 improves security over earlier Wi-Fi protection standards.

questions.text: What is the role of a wireless access point?

answers.text: Bridge wireless clients onto the wired network
Replace the need for all switches

questions.explanation: Access points provide wireless connectivity to the LAN.

questions.text: What does traceroute help an administrator identify?

answers.text: The path traffic takes through network hops
The BIOS version on a PC
The SQL schema of a database

questions.explanation: Traceroute reveals each hop along the path to a destination.

questions.text: Which protocol and message type are used by a basic ping test?
questions.explanation: Ping uses ICMP echo request and echo reply messages.

questions.text: What does a firewall policy do?

answers.text: Allow or block traffic based on defined rules

questions.explanation: Firewalls enforce traffic control based on rule sets.

questions.text: What is the common Ethernet MTU on many IPv4 networks?
questions.explanation: A standard Ethernet MTU is 1500 bytes.

questions.text: What does full duplex mean on an Ethernet link?

answers.text: Devices can send and receive at the same time

questions.explanation: Full-duplex communication supports simultaneous transmission and reception.

questions.text: Which well-known port is used by HTTPS?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses TCP port 443 by default.

questions.text: What is the role of a load balancer?

answers.text: Distribute client requests across multiple servers

questions.explanation: Load balancers spread traffic to improve availability and performance.

questions.text: How does an IPS differ from an IDS?

answers.text: An IPS can block traffic inline
An IPS only works on Wi-Fi

questions.explanation: An intrusion prevention system sits inline and can actively block malicious traffic.

questions.text: What is the purpose of a site-to-site VPN?

answers.text: Securely connect two networks across an untrusted network
Replace switch uplinks inside a rack

questions.explanation: Site-to-site VPNs encrypt traffic between remote networks.

questions.text: Which protocol is commonly used to monitor network devices?
questions.explanation: Simple Network Management Protocol is widely used for monitoring and management.

questions.text: What kind of cable jacket should be used in air-handling spaces when required by code?
questions.explanation: Plenum-rated cable is designed for spaces that handle airflow in buildings.

questions.text: What is a benefit of link aggregation?

answers.text: Multiple physical links can act as one logical connection
It converts copper to fiber automatically

questions.explanation: Link aggregation can improve bandwidth and redundancy.

questions.text: A Windows host has an address beginning with 169.254. What is the most likely cause?

answers.text: It could not obtain a DHCP lease
It has a valid public address from the ISP
It is configured for IPv6 only

questions.explanation: APIPA addresses in 169.254.0.0/16 often appear when DHCP fails.

questions.text: What device is typically used to terminate many copper Ethernet cables in a wiring closet?
questions.explanation: Patch panels provide organized termination points for structured cabling.
